name: The party
summary: Darla, Porridge, Rowan, Sprig, TJ, Rynn and Sal: the heroes who brought down Cryovain and saved Phandalin.

name: Sal
summary: Your friend: a big-hearted, goofy paladin of Ilmater who keeps the peace and keeps everyone laughing. He has told you he once did something terrible, and that he is spending his life making up for it.

name: Phandalin
summary: The frontier town you saved from the white dragon. Your last clear memory is the victory celebration there.

name: Cryovain
summary: The white dragon of Icespire Peak. You killed him.
